notes.title: Office After Hours IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
[b]Attention employees of Endless Solutions! My latest productivity initiative:[/b]
[h2]OFFICE AFTER HOURS IS OUT NOW🎉🎉[/h2]

Clock in and prepare for a shift filled with strange, scary, funny anomalies and an office that’s definitely not just about paperwork.

I’ve brewed this experience with care and a lot of cups of coffee and I hope you enjoy every unsettling minute of it! [b]Here’s what you can expect during your shift:[/b]
[list]
[*]     😱 Story-driven anomalies that are sometimes scary, sometimes just funny or weird
[*]     🕵️‍♂️ Anomaly hunting with a twist – collect clues and items to uncover the truth
[*]     🏢 Explore up to four environments – from the office to more… experimental spaces
[*]     ⏱️ A full playthrough takes around 1–2 hours (plus overtime if you're thorough)
[/list]
Thank you to everyone who followed the development, played the demo, and added the game to your wishlist – your support really means a lot to me! 💼❤️

[h3]For Veteran Spotters[/h3]
If you're an experienced anomaly spotter, the story-driven anomalies might feel like a warm-up. But don’t clock out just yet! Once you’ve made it through your shift, I’ve prepared over 10 additional anomalies designed to truly test your perception and attention to detail.

[h3]Steam Deck[/h3]
Office After Hours is fully playable on Steam Deck, includes full controller support, and supports Steam Cloud, so you can continue your shift anywhere. I'm still waiting on official verification, but performance and controls are working well in testing.

[h3]Office After Hours - Demo[/h3]
If you're still unsure about buying Office After Hours, the demo will be available again soon. I'm just making sure the save system transitions smoothly to the full game, so you won't have to do more overtime than you already do. Depending on what needs fixing after launch, this may still happen this week.

[h3]Next steps[/h3]
I’ll be around to monitor feedback, patch any printer malfunctions, and make sure the coffee keeps flowing. [b]If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a Steam review![/b] It helps me tremendously during launch week! And as a solo developer,[b] it helps me keep creating games.[/b]

📬 Come say hi and discuss anomalies with me [url=https://discord.com/invite/3C8gMWGtvj]on Discord[/url]:

Now… get back to work.
There’s somebody watching😈😉

YoghurtDrop

notes.title: Office After Hours launches on June 2nd!
notes.content:
I’m beyond excited to announce that [b]Office After Hours will be launching on June 2nd, 2025![/b]

It's been a long road, I originally planned to release it in January. But instead of giving you another "just spot the difference" game, I took my time to give you the [b]best possible experience in the anomaly genre[/b].😍

Office After Hours is packed with [b]30 story-based anomalies[/b], that will make you scream or laugh (or both). Four environments, each unlocked step by step, are waiting for you to explore. On top of that, I’ve added over [b]10 additional anomalies[/b] that you can spot after finishing the story! Once the story mode is complete, you can revisit discovered anomalies and hunt for any sweet [b]Easter eggs[/b] you may have missed (Happy Easter, by the way).🥚🐇 

The countdown has officially begun! 6 weeks left.

In the meantime, [b]don’t forget to add Office After Hours to your wishlist[/b] so you’ll get a reminder when the game is released! 🫶

Get ready for shift start 📅💼

notes.title: Worker! Your time has come - report for duty in the playtest.
notes.content:
[h3]Your contract demands sacrifice![/h3]

[b]I’m currently looking for playtesters on Steam to provide feedback on Office After Hours![/b] Your input is invaluable and will help me refine the experience even further. If you’re interested, please feel free to [b]reach out me on discord or X (links below).[/b]

[h3]Current State of the Game[/h3]
The [b]story mode[/b] is now almost complete,[b] featuring 30 unique anomalies[/b] for you to discover, unravel, and survive. There are also more anomalies, that are not related to the story and you can discover them afterwards. I've also [b]added collectible items[/b] so you can track your progress and uncover even more knowledge in the office. The core experience is in place, but I’m focusing on adding layers of polish to ensure every moment feels immersive, mysterious, and impactful.

[h3]Darker Atmosphere to Match the Vibe[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/b5f08e084aa44a2edd098eb0caaa6143e391e801.png[/img]
I’ve transitioned to a darker, moodier lighting setup to better capture the eerie, tense atmosphere of the office.

[h3]Steam Page Refresh Incoming[/h3]
I’m updating the Steam page soon! This includes new screenshots, an updated logo, and a more cohesive presentation that captures the current look and feel of the game. I’m also working hard on an updated trailer.

If you’re interested in playtesting or just want to share your thoughts, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Your feedback helps shape the final experience!

YoghurtDrop

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

I’m excited to share some [b]development updates about Office After Hours[/b]. Over the past weeks, I’ve been hard at work bringing new features and experiences to life, all aimed at making the game even more engaging and unique. Here’s a sneak peek into what’s coming your way:

[h3]1. New Anomalies for a Unique Experience[/h3]
I’m introducing new office-related anomalies that delve into the problems and suffering that can arise in a competitive office environment. These anomalies are designed to reflect the pressures of overwork, unrealistic deadlines, and office politics, immersing you in the emotional weight of these experiences.
[h3]
2. Expanding the Game’s Environments[/h3]
New environments are created to immerse you in the unsettling world of Office After Hours and show you the disturbing story behind the office.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/db6ea10284d6dd05f1ff8de9cb572c3869d9ad46.png[/img]

[h3]3. Story Almost Complete[/h3]
The game’s story is nearly finished. The narrative lets you delve into the dark side of overwork and corporate pressure, guiding you through new environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/b412bf0850285e776442f39bd18a428b62918e95.png[/img]

[h3]4. Cutscenes for Immersion[/h3]
To make the game even more immersive, I’ve added cutscenes that bring key moments to life. These cinematic additions will deepen the story and help you connect with the game’s characters and world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/ec122b827f592bb8e44e616aff70826c1db6ce54.gif[/img]

[h3]5. In-Game Death Mechanics[/h3]
You can now face life-or-death stakes in Office After Hours! With the addition of a death mechanic, your decisions and actions will have greater consequences, adding to the tension and challenge.

[h3]6. New Functions and Features[/h3]
I have added a zoom function so that even small details can be recognised.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/a0a321555a6be630250869c53595753ebd536d9f.gif[/img]


Stay tuned for more updates as I continue refining Office After Hours. The current demo gives a glimpse of the game, but it’s now a bit out of date compared to what the final experience will offer. [b]I’m considering updating the demo[/b] to reflect these exciting changes.

Thank you for being part of this journey.

YoghurtDrop

[u][b]Thank you to everyone who joined during Steam Next Fest[/b][/u], played the demo, and wishlisted the game. Your support and feedback have been very helpful in improving the game.

notes.title: Demo update v0.9.0
notes.content:
First of all[u][b] thanks to everyone who played the demo and wishlisted![/b][/u] 
Also huge thanks to the people that send me feedback. It really helps to improve the game.

This update comes with a performance boost. I had to rework a lot of the core logic because I use a lot more baked lighting now. This also comes with a visual upgrade.

From your feedback I can see that [b]some of the anomalies were too difficult to find[/b] and also some [b]clearer instructions[/b] would be helpful. So I have also made some small changes:
[list]
[*] Better instructions at the beginning of the game
[*] A difficult anomaly can now appear later.
[*] Some difficult anomalies become easier to find after you have missed them.
[/list]
[h3]You also want creepier anomalies. Don't worry, they will come.[/h3]

Before that, I will be working on [b]controller support[/b] and [b]SteamDeck compatibility[/b], which will probably not take much time as I already have things set up.

Please [u][b]continue with the feedback[/b][/u] in the Community Hub or via the [url=https://forms.gle/LLAuNoqqXyYaik1c7]feedback form[/url] so I can give you the best game experience.

By the way, what are you most afraid of in an office? Let me know.

Thanks for your support!
